evidence: Adds rebroadcastwallettx RPC and GUI transaction rebroadcast support in src/wallet/.
rationale: Adds a user-requested feature to rebroadcast unconfirmed wallet transactions without manual hex extraction. The PR description notes that 'From the discussion in #36403, it is clear that there needs to be a way for users to rebroadcast a transaction', resolving an inconvenient manual workaround via `sendrawtransaction`.
